title: Logging and Monitoring
description: Structured logging, log aggregation, and application monitoring packages.
longDescription: This module covers the most popular logging frameworks and monitoring tools for .NET Core applications. You will learn how to set up structured logging with Serilog, NLog, and other providers, and how to monitor applications in production.
whatYouLearn: Set up structured logging with Serilog
Configure NLog for file and console output
Use Seq for log aggregation and searching
Monitor applications with Prometheus and Application Insights
